decision: Is native pixel motion comparison accessible while fixed early neural and final-memory probes remain weak, and does matched external pre/post access help? Not a remedy selection or causal lesion test.
reuse: 425 train groups and 100 validation groups from FrozenDiagnostic; validation is exploratory because reused across prior diagnostics. Previous test is never used for fitting or selection.
fixed_capacity: Two 32-dimensional fixed random projections of baseline/post versus two permutations of final representation, expanded into 64 linear plus 2080 quadratic coordinates. Same groups, output targets, alpha candidates, scaler and coefficient counts across sites/access. Separate train-only standardization.
targets: Joint cos/sin of actual circular post-minus-pre movement angle for both physical patches (4 outputs); any-event binary (2); left/right binary fitted and scored on actual events only (2). Metadata provides training/evaluation targets only, never feature selection or operational input.
selection: validation minimum joint circular MAE for change; validation BA for classifiers; first wins ties; no refit; all fits and pixel thresholds hash frozen before fresh test generation
controls: Entire physical-group target shuffle for each target; same validation candidate selection; zero-change baseline; reused full-dimensional per-phase direction fits evaluated on fresh test without new selection; final-only removal/NaN invariance
pixel: Reuse isolated bilinear-dot centroid matching, known mass .48 and speed .375+/- .015, geometry, onset/event timing from sequence length, decoded visible cue. Full history versus last two transitions pre/post (stack3-matched instantaneous temporal window). No true dot IDs or directions enter observer. Pixel-derived flow sums/counts saved for numerical replay.
pixel_thresholds: 1..40 degrees, max validation BA separately for any-event and target-report, full and endpoint windows. Side by greatest absolute signed estimated change, independent of cue. No true cue selection.
uncertainty: 500 independent fresh-group bootstrap resamples, native-original rows only for headline metrics; cue variants not independent samples. Matched resamples for gains. Report event/catch counts and errors separately.
limits: External pre/post access not a deployed head. Spatial ROIs versus full memory remain unequal before capacity matching. KDA recurrence has history unlike instantaneous CNN. Failure does not prove erasure; no pooling attenuation claim. Finite sample, feature projection and quadratic probe limitations remain.
budget: existing immutable budget.json, 1200 seconds total, threads<=2 one worker, including reporting; no renewal
